name: terrain
description: Map terrain over ctx.noise: a heightfield, slope-aware surfacing (rock on steep drops, soil ≥2 thick, shores, snow), a downhill river carver with mud/clay banks, and jittered paths with nibbled edges and slab steps.
exports: heightfield({ x, z, w, d, height(x, z) }) → Heightfield { at, set, steepness, water, bank, occupied }
carveRiver(ctx, field, { points, width, depth?, widen?, meander? }) — call before surface
surface(ctx, field, { style?: temperate|alpine|desert, bottom?, sea?, soil?, snowAbove? })
path(ctx, field, { points, width?, style?: rural|town|rough, wander? }) → { cells } — call after surface
trace(points) → cells along a polyline; key(x, z) → occupied-set key
